description: Product attribute extraction (AI + offline checks) — Turns a product title/description (text=) into catalog attributes: brand, product type, model, color, size, material, pack count, weight, volume, dimensions, gender, age group, condition, features, compatibility, plus category path, a clean short title, search keywords and missing attributes. Every value is checked against the text offline (unsupported brand/model/size/quantity dropped); weight/volume units, pack counts and UPC/EAN/GTIN check digits are parsed without AI; listing quality score and tips. Optional category=, fields= (extra attribute names). Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Anker PowerCore 10000 Portable Charger, 2-Pack, Black, 180g, UPC 848061073799

name: ai_product_attributes
